description: Aider-polyglot style (Kotlin): read digits drawn in 3x4 character cells, joining several rows with commas and marking unreadable cells with a question mark. Twist against the textbook exercise: lines arrive right-trimmed and must be padded to the longest line of the whole input, blank cells read as spaces, a mark in the spare fourth line makes a cell unreadable, and wrong grid sizes throw. A plain Kotlin test runner compiled by run_tests.py is the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier runs it for a repair round.
